reviews.comment: Note: This was Real Analysis at URochester. Extremely difficult course. Prof. Huang was super helpful and accessible outside of class. The lectures were...OK. He repeated the proofs and problems from the textbook and didn't explain them as clearly as the book itself. It might be that he is still building up teaching experience.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment:
NOTE: I took Math 142 at U of R.
Professor Huang was awful, surely the worst math teacher I've ever had. He's very difficult to understand, does all of his notes on an iPad making it hard to follow along, and simply does problems out from the textbook! He doesn't teach!!! He just does problems. Do not take his class if you want to be able to learn.

He is a really nice guy! Though he is average, he really cares about the students, and always tried make sure we were on track. Some of his explanations for certain topics were confusing, so teaching yourself was needed sometimes. His accent is strong but you can catch on after a week. Overall, he really wants you to succeed.

Overall, I'd say he's a pretty good professor! He goes through the notes pretty well, and he always asks if anyone has questions before moving onto the next problem. He posts his notes, too, just so you have a reference when going through old notes/studying for exams. Exams aren't too bad, just make sure you're well prepared beforehand.
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Test heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: He literally will just skip notes, I succeeded in the class, but I had to teach myself everything. If I asked a question, he would not give me a good answer on how to fix my problem. Horrible experience with him.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Was really nice and made sure everyone was following along. Slight accent however got the message through. Was able to email/talk to him if I had any trouble on homework or questions in general. Emailed him once after I wasn't able to complete a homework assignment because I didn't fully understand the topic and he postponed the assignment.
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Test heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: He is a great professor. He has a strong accent and doesn't know a lot of words in English for specific questions. He couldn't tell you how to buy a scantron but he was very nice, funny, and tried to make sure everyone understood what was happening.
